label: marp: watch presentation
args: marp --watch --html --allow-local-files presentation/main.md --output presentation/main.html & html_pid=$!; marp --watch --pdf --html --allow-local-files --browser firefox --browser-path /Applications/Zen.app/Contents/MacOS/zen presentation/main.md --output presentation/main.pdf & pdf_pid=$!; trap 'kill $html_pid $pdf_pid 2>/dev/null' INT TERM EXIT; wait
